protocol.status: Fully frozen before the first market replay; execution and kernel synthetic tests completed; no new pending outcomes have been read
protocol.purpose: Frozen strict172 nested effective annual restore versus permanent pending hold after the original individual-L annual drawdown crossing, with no human response through H; descriptive execution ablation, no final adoption.

data.hash_convention: Hash only guarded ids/returns/inflation arrays; never hash or parse unrequested final return values.
data.history: Reused development scenarios; earlier final exposure is acknowledged. No fresh blind test or pooled learned-policy certificate.

protocol.population: Frozen strict172 nested effective assignments for full120 and the exact five original96train/24test contexts. No fit or calibration function is called. A/D Review remain financial NULL in both arms; all original profile-path rows remain in denominators.

parameters.trigger: First annual endpoint tau with running real MDD-L>1e-12; initial100 is included. L is the original individual response.
parameters.pending: After observing crossing tau, hold the actual holdings with no trades from return-year tau+1 through original H. No adviser response or automatic re-entry.
parameters.observations: Original initial/annual endpoints; no extra fee-observation trigger, no continuous price assumption.
parameters.fees: Same exact self-financing fee including mandatory initial allocation in both arms; crossing-year fee remains; no later discretionary fee, terminal liquidation or refund.

protocol.accounting: Original joint returns and inflation continue during pending. Maintain actual holdings, CPI, real running peak, running MDD and absorbing ever-breached flag without resets. Every profile uses a fresh original100 path for its own H.

recovery.reference: At first crossing freeze its historical real peak P_tau.
recovery.criterion: First later annual endpoint t>tau with real wealth R_t>=P_tau, using ordinary float >= without adding a policy loss allowance.
recovery.fields: recovery_year and recovery_delay are NULL when not recovered; right_censored=true and available_followup=H-tau for triggered unrecovered paths; observed_survival_time is recovery_delay if recovered, otherwise H-tau. No trigger: all recovery/censor/follow-up fields are NULL.
recovery.summaries: Always disclose trigger/recovered/censored denominators. Do not average right-censored paths as finite recovered times; any recovered-only delay summary is explicitly selected.

acceptance_checks: Resolve all frozen dependency hashes before data access; exact local172→original232 mapping and frozen targets/assignments
Replay original annual path metrics against saved effective strict172 artifacts before producing comparative results
Per assigned path same first crossing and completed-H breach flag in both arms, including no-crossing and crossing-at-H cases
Identical holdings/wealth/CPI/peak/MDD/actions/fees through crossing; pending has no later trades; untriggered arms identical through H
Financial identity and cost=.0025*moved; no double fee, no reset, correct original H and annual observation times
Recompute recovery from actual paths and frozen P_tau; preserve right censoring and ReviewNULL
Source/input end SHA matches start; output hashes and trace group schema recorded

outcomes.all_assigned: Per profile and full/OOF context, all-path net real terminal wealth/G/CAGR/MDD/CVaR/excess/nominal fees/moved/actual trades, preserving every path pair.
outcomes.triggered_only: Same metrics plus D_tau and added severity max(D_H-D_tau,0), recovery/censor/follow-up and all arm paired changes; explicit selected subgroup. Added severity is the increase of historical maximum drawdown after the trigger, not a newly defined loss relative to trigger wealth.
outcomes.breach: Invariant acceptance check only, never a benefit endpoint; difference must be zero.

protocol.output: results/model_review/review_pending_execution_v1/ with client_path_metrics.csv (both arms and ReviewNULL), paired_path_differences.csv, summaries, yearly_trace.csv, executed_paths.npz, context/provenance metadata and manifest.
prohibited: Refitting, recalibration, target/menu/assignment changes or new triggers/delays
Inferring real adviser benefits, response probabilities or optimal permanent inaction
Selecting a winner or saying referral restores the already-crossed risk budget
Claiming mandatory annual restore plus referral resolves the remaining Q2 benefit gate/target update decision
Modifying old artifacts, frozen packages, src, report or notebook

summary_metadata.median_method: numpy.median; mean of the two middle values for even sample sizes
summary_metadata.cvar90_definition: average of the worst 10% probability mass, including fractional boundary atoms
summary_metadata.risk_event: MDD - L > 1e-12; smaller differences treated as numerical equality

units: G is annualized log real wealth growth; fees/moved are cumulative nominal initial-100 wealth units, not return percentage points. Recovery at annual endpoints with fixed trigger peak and explicit right censoring.
scope: Frozen strict172 products and effective assignments, post-crossing no-human-response hold scenario only. No lower everbreach probability, adviser improvement, optimal hold or final adoption claim. Annual restore is a research comparator and does not resolve Q2 benefit-gating/target updates. Learned OOF policies differ across folds and do not give a pooled fixed-policy certificate.
